units.source_text: 我买刀和药是备万一寻死用的。

en.t: I bought the knife and the medicine in case I should need them to kill myself.

units.source_text: 不过，这种采购像行将建立新家庭的男子汉按照制定的某种生活设计而采购一样，使我心旷神仙。

en.t: And yet this shopping made me feel exhilarated, like a man about to establish a new household buying things according to some carefully planned design for life.

units.source_text: 回到寺庙之后，我对这两件东西百看不厌。

en.t: After returning to the temple, I never tired of looking at these two things.

units.source_text: 我从刀鞘把刀拔了出来，舔了舔小刀的刀刃。

en.t: I drew the knife from its sheath and lightly licked the blade of the small knife.

units.source_text: 刀刃立即蒙上一层烟云，舌头明显地感觉一阵冰凉，随后又感到一段隐隐的甘甜。

en.t: The blade was immediately covered with a misty film, and my tongue distinctly felt a burst of coldness, followed by a faint sweetness.

units.source_text: 这股甘甜是从这薄薄的钢的深处，从无法到达的钢的本质，隐约地透出来，传到了舌头上。

en.t: This sweetness seemed to seep dimly from deep within the thin steel, from the unreachable essence of the steel, and pass onto my tongue.

units.source_text: 这种明确的形状，这种似深海湛蓝的铁的光泽……它和唾液一起具有一种永远缠绕在舌尖上的清凉的甘甜。

en.t: This definite shape, this iron sheen like the deep blue of the sea... together with saliva, it held a cool sweetness that would cling forever to the tip of the tongue.

units.source_text: 不久，这种甘甜也消去了。

en.t: Before long, that sweetness too faded away.

units.source_text: 我愉快地思考着：有朝一日，我的肉体将陶醉在这种甘甜的飞泳中。

en.t: I thought with pleasure that one day my body would be intoxicated as it swam through this sweetness.

units.source_text: 死的天空十分明亮，犹如生的天空一样。

en.t: The sky of death was very bright, just like the sky of life.

units.source_text: 于是，我忘却了这种阴暗的思想。

en.t: And so I forgot this gloomy thought.

units.source_text: 因为这个世界不存在苦痛。

en.t: For in this world, pain did not exist.
